$comment: The app icons' white glyphs (sidebar, tool marks). Generated with `pnpm assets:icons` on your ChatGPT plan, traced to vectors, and rendered as 4096px transparent masters (assets-src/icons) plus the 256px images the app uses (public/icons). `pick` is the variant that shipped; re-run one icon with `pnpm assets:icons relight`.
style: Design one icon glyph for the sidebar of a premium creative app. Style: a solid, filled glyph in pure white (#FFFFFF), slightly bold and geometric, with softly rounded corners. Interior details are clean negative-space cut-outs (transparent), never thin lines or outlines; where a stroke is unavoidable it is thick and rounded (about 9% of the glyph width). Flat vector look, like a premium SF Symbols '.fill' icon: no gradient, no shadow, no glow, no 3D shading, no texture, no text, no letters, no numbers. One glyph only, centered, with even padding: the glyph fills about 65% of the canvas. Crisp anti-aliased edges. Fully transparent background (real alpha channel); only the white glyph is visible.

icons.subject: A house: a pentagon with a rounded peak and rounded eaves, and a rounded rectangular door cut out at the bottom center. No chimney, no windows.

A photo: a solid rounded-square picture with two mountain peaks and a small round sun cut out as negative space. A small solid four-pointed sparkle star sits just outside the top-right corner, separated from the picture by a clear transparent gap.

A stack of photo cards: a solid front card (rounded rectangle) with a small mountain shape cut out of it, and two cards peeking out behind it above, each slightly narrower than the one in front, separated by clear transparent gaps.

A graphics card seen from the front: a solid wide rounded rectangle with one large round fan cut out as negative space (a ring with three curved blades), and a short row of solid connector pins along the bottom edge.
A power plug: a solid rounded plug body with two short rounded prongs on top, and a short thick cable with a rounded end leaving the bottom of the plug.
An isometric cube made of three solid faces (top, left, right), separated by thin transparent gaps, like an elegant 'cube.fill' icon.

Viral templates: two tall vertical video cards fanned out like playing cards, the back card tilted to the left and peeking out behind, the front card upright with a solid rounded play triangle cut out of its center as negative space, and a small solid four-pointed sparkle star just outside the front card's top-right corner, every piece separated by clear transparent gaps.

A film clapperboard: a solid rounded slate with its hinged clapper bar on top, opened at a slight upward angle; the clapper bar and the top strip of the slate have bold diagonal stripes cut out as negative space.

Re-shoot from a new angle: a small solid cube seen from a three-quarter view at the center (its three faces separated by thin transparent gaps), with one bold curved arrow sweeping around it in a three-quarter circle and ending in a rounded arrowhead.

Light direction: a circular disc whose left half is solid white and whose right half is only a thick white ring outline (transparent inside), surrounded by eight short, thick, rounded rays evenly spaced around it.

Two people: a solid person silhouette (round head above rounded shoulders) in front on the left, and a second, slightly smaller person silhouette behind it on the right, separated from the front one by a clear transparent gap.

A paintbrush: a solid brush lying diagonally, handle toward the top-right and a rounded bristle tip toward the bottom-left, with a small transparent gap between the handle and the metal ferrule, plus a small solid four-pointed sparkle star near the top-left.

A product on a podium: a solid perfume bottle with a small square cap (separated from the bottle by a thin transparent gap) standing on a low round podium seen slightly from above, separated from the podium by a thin transparent gap.

A video camera: a solid rounded rectangular camera body with a play triangle cut out of its center, and a solid lens hood shaped like a rounded trapezoid on its right side, separated from the body by a small transparent gap.

Motion graphics: a solid rounded play triangle pointing right, with two short solid rounded speed streaks trailing from its left side, and a small solid four-pointed sparkle star just above its top-right corner, every piece separated by clear transparent gaps.

Swap a person: a solid person silhouette (round head above rounded shoulders) at the center, enclosed by two bold curved arrows that form a circle around it, one on top pointing clockwise and one on the bottom pointing clockwise, like a refresh symbol.

Enlarge: two bold diagonal arrows pointing outward, one to the top-right corner and one to the bottom-left corner, each with a rounded arrowhead, and a small solid four-pointed sparkle star at the center between them.
A storyboard: three solid rounded panels laid out like a comic page, two squarish panels side by side on top and one wide panel across the bottom, separated by clear transparent gaps.
